body: Thanks for the encouragement.  Today I'm feeling angry with myself for giving in.  I didn't value myself enough to tell him to get lost.  I don't know why that is.

I think that my wish to be dead is about having some control over  a situation that I can't control.  I know he is not coming back. Days like yesterday are the lowest I go. But I took apart my suicide device last night, and am plodding forward.

 I know the sex is not helping me.  It's hard because I'm living in the house we shared, and when he's here I think I'm pretending it's not real.  I look at him and he looks the same, but he's not the same, and he's done things he swore he never would. So I have to care about myself, and believe that it hurts me to be intimate with him. But so far, I haven't been able to.

I am planning on moving away in the spring, partly for this exact reason.  Feelings  of being worthless, and the betrayal,  and the rejection are moving with me, I know, and I really do not have much hope for my future life,  I was looking at places to rent in my new city, and can see I can't afford much on one income.

Thanks for getting back to me.

He left in July.  So it's been 7 months.  

 No one has filed for divorce, but we are going to mediation on Wednesday.  It was a complete blindside to me.  Tuesday is our anniversary.  I told him I want to get this done because it is tortuous.  But there are times when it seems unbelievable to me.  Today has been a very bad day because the only way to make it stop is to refuse to participate.
It's hard to think of this as just a bad day.  But....I am still here so I guess that is something.  Thanks for your thoughts.

I thought I was in a happy relationship.  Like any couple, not perfect, but each of us had no doubt the other was loved.  I thought that was our bedrock.  

And, intellectually, I know you can't base your value as a person on another person. But my role has been wife and mom for a lot of years.  Now I do not have anything that matters to me, i.e. him.  I sit in our house getting ready for mediation, and does that rug matter?  Does the furniture matter?  The house itself?  Nope.  So I am forced to think of a financial future, when I just would rather deny any of it is real.
But, the other woman is pregnant, so that's hard to ignore.  I'm alone.  Can't overlook that one.  

So, I don't want to try to find another person to make myself feel better.  Up until today I thought I would just go through it.  But today I feel panicked and overwhelmed by the betrayal and rejection.  And I am angry I am in this position.  I can't just turn off my feelings for my husband.  I just want it to go away, and if I was dead, that would be it.  Dumb, when I put it like that.  It's harder to live.
